page_title: RAY 0-1 ALM | Rayo Vallecano v Almeria 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) hits a dangerous effort towards the left post from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Luis Maximiano.
90+4' Cesar Montes (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' The foul by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francisco Maeso.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar.
88' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) loses the defending players and unloads a powerful, but inaccurate effort from long distance. The goalkeeper remains completely calm as the ball ends somewhere in row Z.

87' This was a piece of cake for Luis Maximiano. Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.

86' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
83' Pepe Mel has decided to make a change. Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) replaces Edgar Gonzalez.
82' Sergio Arribas goes off the pitch and Iddrisu Baba (Almeria) comes on.
82' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

81' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Luis Maximiano!
81' Good work from Rayo Vallecano as they win a corner.
80' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Ivan Balliu and he is replaced by Miguel Crespo (Rayo Vallecano).
80' That will be all from Alvaro Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
79' Yellow card. Marcos Pena (Almeria) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
78' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
77' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
77' The attendance for today's match is 10864.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luis Suarez (Almeria) will replace Choco Lozano.
74' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
72' Pepe Mel decides to make a substitution. Leo Baptistao will be replaced by Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
71' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Luis Maximiano.
68' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' Substitution. Unai Lopez is replaced by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Marc Pubill (Almeria) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball into the stands. Nice run, but poor finish!
59' Here is a change. Radamel Falcao is going off and Inigo Perez gives the last tactical orders to Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
59' We are about to witness a substitution. Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Isi Palazon.
58' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the top of the net from distance, but Luis Maximiano hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
55' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
54' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
52' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Luis Maximiano was alert and made a comfortable save.
51' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) brings an opponent down and Francisco Maeso interrupts the game.
50' A cross from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
48' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Stole Dimitrievski.
43' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
43' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.
40' A pass lands at the feet of Adrian Embarba (Almeria) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
39' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
36' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.

36' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the left side of the goal. Luis Maximiano is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
33' A precise low pass is received by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
32' The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.

30' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Adrian Embarba slips the ball through to Choco Lozano (Almeria), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
26' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
24' A crossfield pass from Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates.
20' Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
17' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.

16' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to threaten the opposition goal with the direct free kick. He unloads a thunderbolt strike directed into the top right corner. The goalkeeper stretches and makes a superb save.
14' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Luis Maximiano.
13' Marc Pubill (Almeria) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
10' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
6' Some neat passing and movement from Almeria as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
